title: Cambridge, England — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cambridge, England: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cambridge is a city in England with a population of 145,000. A world-renowned university city on the River Cam, famous for its historic colleges, punting, and status as a leading global tech and biotech hub. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
